airport.name: Willmar Municipal Airport John L Rice Field (2006)

summary: Willmar Municipal Airport John L Rice Field is a small general aviation facility serving Willmar, Minnesota, in the heart of Kandiyohi County. The field was renamed in 2006 to honor John L. Rice, a local aviation advocate. It primarily supports private, recreational, and business aviation in west-central Minnesota.
